verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a public register search portal: register entries, submitted documents, announcements, a publication platform and the Bilanz-Navigator disclosure guide. Nothing in it describes AI-generated insights or suggestions. AI-assisted insights are a plausible feature for a data and search portal, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence the product delivers it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
